description: Verify Catalog page loads with search bar, all filter dropdowns, and product cards
preconditions: Seller is logged in with valid credentials
expected_result: Catalog page loads with search bar, 4 filter dropdowns, and product cards

description: Verify search bar filters products in real-time by Brand, Product Name, or Category
preconditions: Seller is on Catalog page with products available
steps: Scroll down and up to verify results
expected_result: Search bar filters products in real-time. Results update as you type.

description: Verify Super Category dropdown opens, has internal search, and shows category options
steps: Verify search input appears inside dropdown
Type a category name in the search
expected_result: Super Category dropdown opens with search input. Typing filters the list. Selecting an option filters products.

description: Verify Brand dropdown opens, has internal search, and filters products by brand
steps: Type a brand name to search
expected_result: Brand dropdown opens with search. Selecting a brand filters the product list accordingly.

description: Verify SKU Status filter shows all status options (Available, Already Listed, Requested, Incomplete)
expected_result: SKU Status filter shows 4 options. Clicking one filters products by that status.

description: Verify Sort dropdown opens and displays all sorting options (Popular, Recently Added, Product Name, etc.)
expected_result: Sort dropdown shows all sorting options. Selecting one reorders the product list.

description: Verify More section reveals Category dropdown with internal search
steps: Type a category name to search
expected_result: More section reveals Category dropdown. It has an internal search input that filters options.

description: Verify More section reveals Packing Size dropdown with internal search
steps: Type a packing size to search
expected_result: More section reveals Packing Size dropdown. It has an internal search input.

description: Verify All Products and Requested tabs toggle correctly
expected_result: Both tabs visible. Toggling between them changes the displayed product list.

description: Verify catalog page scrolls smoothly and product cards persist after scrolling
expected_result: Page scrolls smoothly. Product cards remain visible and interactive after scrolling.

description: Verify Card Type 1 (Addable) has '+' button that opens Add Product Modal
preconditions: Seller is on Catalog page with at least one addable product
steps: Find a product card with '+' button
expected_result: Clicking '+' on an addable card opens the Add Product modal. (Skips if no addable card exists.)

description: Verify Card Type 2 (Manage Listing) button opens Edit Product Modal
preconditions: Seller has at least one listed product
steps: Find a product card with 'Manage Listing' button
expected_result: Clicking 'Manage Listing' opens the Edit Product modal. (Skips if no listed card exists.)

description: Verify Card Type 3 (Incomplete) has 'Request Product' button that opens Request Product Modal
preconditions: Seller is on Catalog page with incomplete products
steps: Find a product card with 'Request Product' button
expected_result: Clicking 'Request Product' opens the modal with HSN Code, Your Price, and other required fields.

description: Verify Card Type 4 (Requested) shows 'Requested' status badge
preconditions: Seller has at least one requested product
expected_result: At least one product card shows a 'Requested' status badge.

description: Verify Card Type 5 (Item Blocked) shows blocked/OOS status
preconditions: Seller has at least one blocked/OOS product
steps: Check for 'Blocked', 'OOS', or 'Out of Stock' text on page
expected_result: Blocked/OOS cards show appropriate status text. (Skips if none found.)

description: Verify 'Incorrect?' link on product cards opens the Incorrect Product Modal with all fields
expected_result: Incorrect Product modal opens with issue dropdown, comment textarea, and Request Change button.

description: Verify 'Request Variant' link opens a modal with form fields
steps: Click 'Request Variant' on a product card
expected_result: Request Variant modal opens with pre-filled form fields from the parent product.

description: Verify Request Product modal shows all required fields (Master Pack, Dead Weight, L/B/H, HSN, Image, MRP, Your Price, Expiry, In Stock)
expected_result: All fields from the PRD are present in the Request Product modal.

description: Verify Request Product modal — fill all required fields (dimensions, HSN, image, MRP, price, expiry) and submit
steps: Ensure In Stock toggle is on
Verify Request Product button is enabled
expected_result: After filling all required fields, the Request Product button enables. Clicking submit processes the request.

description: Verify Request Variant modal shows pre-filled fields and form inputs
steps: Verify inputs have values (pre-filled from parent)
expected_result: Request Variant modal opens with pre-filled fields inherited from the parent product.

description: Verify Incorrect Product modal — select issue type, add comment, and submit
steps: Verify Request Change button is enabled
expected_result: After selecting issue and adding comment, the Request Change button enables and submission succeeds.

description: Verify Add/Edit Product modal opens from Manage Listing and contains HSN, MRP, Your Price fields
preconditions: Seller has at least one listed product
steps: Click 'Manage Listing' on a product card
expected_result: Add/Edit Product modal opens with HSN, MRP, Your Price, and other fields. (Skips if no listed product.)

description: Verify Create New Product modal opens from 'Could not find your product?' section with all fields
preconditions: Seller scrolls to find the section (appears after every 10 items)
steps: Scroll down to find 'Could not find your product?' section
Verify Brand, Product Name, Packing, HSN, MRP, Your Price fields present
expected_result: Create New Product modal opens with all required fields. (Skips if section not found.)
